-- DEXHUB RASENGAN 360 STARTUP INTRO
-- Embedded local image + 360-degree spin animation.
do
    pcall(function()
        local Players = game:GetService("Players")
        local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        local player = Players.LocalPlayer
        if not player then return end
        local pg = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
        if not pg then return end
        local old = pg:FindFirstChild("DEXHubStartupIntro")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
        local INTRO_IMG_B64 = ""
        local INTRO_IMG_FILE = "DEXHub_Rasengan360.png"
        local imageAsset
        if type(writefile) == "function" and type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
            local exists = false
            pcall(function() exists = isfile and isfile(INTRO_IMG_FILE) or false end)
            if not exists then
                pcall(function() writefile(INTRO_IMG_FILE, HttpService:Base64Decode(INTRO_IMG_B64)) end)
            end
            pcall(function() imageAsset = getcustomasset(INTRO_IMG_FILE) end)
        end
        local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        gui.Name = "DEXHubStartupIntro"; gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true; gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
        gui.DisplayOrder = 999999; gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling; gui.Parent = pg
        local bg = Instance.new("Frame"); bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1); bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(2,5,10); bg.BorderSizePixel=0; bg.Parent=gui
        local glow = Instance.new("Frame"); glow.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); glow.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.47); glow.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.6,.65); glow.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,130,255); glow.BackgroundTransparency=.9; glow.BorderSizePixel=0; glow.ZIndex=2; glow.Parent=bg; Instance.new("UICorner",glow).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
        local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel"); image.Name="Rasengan360"; image.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); image.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.47); image.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.72,.68); image.BackgroundTransparency=1; image.ImageTransparency=1; image.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit; image.ZIndex=4; image.Parent=bg
        if imageAsset then image.Image=imageAsset end
        local title=Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0); title.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.77); title.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.8,.08); title.BackgroundTransparency=1; title.Text="DEX HUB"; title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack; title.TextScaled=true; title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255); title.TextTransparency=1; title.ZIndex=6; title.Parent=bg
        local sub=Instance.new("TextLabel"); sub.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0); sub.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.845); sub.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.85,.04); sub.BackgroundTransparency=1; sub.Text="RASENGAN // CHARGING"; sub.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; sub.TextSize=12; sub.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(145,205,255); sub.TextTransparency=1; sub.ZIndex=6; sub.Parent=bg
        local skip=Instance.new("TextButton"); skip.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1); skip.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.98,.96); skip.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(82,30); skip.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,12,18); skip.BackgroundTransparency=.12; skip.Text="SKIP"; skip.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold; skip.TextSize=10; skip.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(220,230,240); skip.ZIndex=8; skip.Parent=bg; Instance.new("UICorner",skip).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,8)
        local done=false; local conn; local voiceSound
        local function closeIntro()
            if done then return end; done=true; if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
            if voiceSound then pcall(function() voiceSound:Stop(); voiceSound:Destroy() end); voiceSound=nil end
            local t=TweenInfo.new(.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
            pcall(function() TweenService:Create(image,t,{ImageTransparency=1,Size=UDim2.fromScale(.82,.77)}):Play(); TweenService:Create(title,t,{TextTransparency=1}):Play(); TweenService:Create(sub,t,{TextTransparency=1}):Play(); TweenService:Create(bg,t,{BackgroundTransparency=1}):Play() end)
            task.delay(.35,function() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end)
        end
        skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeIntro)
        conn=UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed) if not processed and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then closeIntro() end end)
        if imageAsset then TweenService:Create(image,TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{ImageTransparency=0}):Play() end
        -- Exact sync point: voice starts on the same frame the DEX HUB title begins appearing.
        pcall(function()
            local voiceAsset = getDEXHubVoiceAsset()
            if voiceAsset then
                voiceSound = Instance.new("Sound")
                voiceSound.Name = "DEXHubVoiceIntro"
                voiceSound.SoundId = voiceAsset
                voiceSound.Volume = 2.5
                voiceSound.Looped = false
                voiceSound.Parent = SoundService
                voiceSound:Play()
            end
        end)
        TweenService:Create(title,TweenInfo.new(.3),{TextTransparency=0}):Play(); task.delay(.15,function() if not done then TweenService:Create(sub,TweenInfo.new(.25),{TextTransparency=0}):Play() end end)
        task.spawn(function()
            local duration=1.35; local start=os.clock()
            while not done and os.clock()-start<duration do
                local a=math.clamp((os.clock()-start)/duration,0,1)
                if imageAsset then image.Rotation=-22+360*a; local p=1+math.sin(a*math.pi*2)*.04; image.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.72*p,.68*p) end
                sub.Text=(a<.3 and "RASENGAN // CHARGING") or (a<.72 and "DEX HUB // SPIN 360°") or "DEX HUB // READY"
                task.wait()
            end
            if not done then closeIntro() end
        end)
    end)
end

M.introSoundEnabled = true M.introSongChoice = 10 M.introGUIEnabled = true M.stopSongAfterIntro = false M.introClipDuration = 10 M._introDone = false local DEXHub_CFG_FILE = "DEXHubDuels_v3.json" local DEXHub_CFG_VERSION = 6 if isfile and isfile(DEXHub_CFG_FILE) then local ok, data = pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(readfile(DEXHub_CFG_FILE)) end) if ok and type(data) == "table" and tonumber(data.configVersion) == DEXHub_CFG_VERSION then if data.introSoundEnabled ~= nil then M.introSoundEnabled = data.introSoundEnabled end if data.introSongChoice then M.introSongChoice = math.clamp(tonumber(data.introSongChoice) or 10, 1, 10) end if data.introGUIEnabled ~= nil then M.introGUIEnabled = data.introGUIEnabled end if data.stopSongAfterIntro ~= nil then M.stopSongAfterIntro = data.stopSongAfterIntro == true end if type(data.Theme) == "string" then M._savedTheme = data.Theme end if type(data.colorScheme) == "string" then M._savedTheme = data.colorScheme end end end M.INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS = { {name="Jealous", url="https://files.catbox.moe/ihjlwy.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_8.mp3"}, {name="Cinderella", url="https://files.catbox.moe/5k4gof.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_9.mp3"}, {name="Everglades", url="https://files.catbox.moe/iknfuh.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_5.mp3"}, {name="Nuts", url="https://files.catbox.moe/dvjtjk.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_7.mp3"}, {name="Addicted", url="https://files.catbox.moe/i8j2pt.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_10.mp3"}, {name="Pure Cocaine", url="https://files.catbox.moe/mzvrir.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_6.mp3"}, {name="Handsome", url="https://files.catbox.moe/6eigoh.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_2.mp3"}, {name="Sketchers", url="https://files.catbox.moe/rcgr9f.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_4.mp3"}, {name="thinkin", url="https://files.catbox.moe/2a7jyx.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_3.mp3"}, {name="Blue Bands", url="https://files.catbox.moe/iyw1cb.mp3", file="DEXHubCCIntroSong_1.mp3"}, } M.introSongCache = {} M.introPlaybackSound = nil introSoundInstance = nil M._introPlayToken = 0 function M.getIntroSongNames() local names = {} for i, opt in ipairs(M.INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS) do names[i] = opt.name end return names end function M.cacheIntroSong(option)
    if not option then return nil end
    -- Use an executor-local authorized audio file if present.
    if option.file and option.file ~= "" and isfile and getcustomasset then
        local okFile, exists = pcall(function() return isfile(option.file) end)
        if okFile and exists then
            local okAsset, asset = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(option.file) end)
            if okAsset and asset then
                M.introSongCache[option.file] = asset
                return asset
            end
        end
    end
    -- Otherwise use the Roblox asset ID. Keep fallbacks so a removed/blocked ID can be retried immediately.
    if option.assetId then
        local aid = tostring(option.assetId):gsub("^rbxassetid://", "")
        if aid:match("^%d+$") and aid ~= "0" then
            return "rbxassetid://" .. aid
        end
    end
    -- Existing DEXHub URL songs.
    if not option.url or option.url == "" then return nil end
    local fileName = option.file or ("DEXHubIntro_" .. tostring(option.name) .. ".mp3")
    if M.introSongCache[fileName] then return M.introSongCache[fileName] end
    local hasFile = false
    pcall(function() hasFile = isfile and isfile(fileName) end)
    if hasFile and getcustomasset then
        local ok, asset = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(fileName) end)
        if ok and asset then M.introSongCache[fileName] = asset return asset end
    end
    if writefile and getcustomasset then
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(option.url) end)
        if ok and data then
            pcall(function() writefile(fileName, data) end)
            local ok2, asset = pcall(function() return getcustomasset(fileName) end)
            if ok2 and asset then M.introSongCache[fileName] = asset return asset end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function M.stopIntroMusic()
    M._introPlayToken = (tonumber(M._introPlayToken) or 0) + 1
    if M.introPlaybackSound then
        pcall(function() M.introPlaybackSound:Stop() end)
        pcall(function() M.introPlaybackSound:Destroy() end)
        M.introPlaybackSound = nil
    end
    if introSoundInstance then
        pcall(function() introSoundInstance:Stop() end)
        pcall(function() introSoundInstance:Destroy() end)
        introSoundInstance = nil
    end
end

function M.playIntroMusic()
    if M.introSoundEnabled == false then return end
    M.stopIntroMusic()
    local playToken = M._introPlayToken

    local idx = math.clamp(tonumber(M.introSongChoice) or 10, 1, #M.INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS)
    local option = M.INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[idx]
    if not option then return end

    task.spawn(function()
        local soundId = M.cacheIntroSong(option)
        if playToken ~= M._introPlayToken then return end
        if not soundId then
            warn("[DEXHub Audio] No audio source for " .. tostring(option.name) .. ". A working Roblox audio asset or authorized local MP3 is required.")
            return
        end

        -- INSTANT PLAY: no preload and no 12-second wait. Try the primary ID immediately.
        -- If Roblox rejects it, retry the listed fallback IDs without blocking startup.
        local ids = {}
        -- Local getcustomasset() sources are already valid SoundIds; use them directly.
        if type(soundId) == "string" and soundId ~= "" and not soundId:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") then
            table.insert(ids, soundId)
        end
        if option.fallbackIds and type(option.fallbackIds) == "table" then
            for _, id in ipairs(option.fallbackIds) do table.insert(ids, tostring(id)) end
        elseif option.assetId then
            table.insert(ids, tostring(option.assetId))
        end
        if #ids == 0 and soundId then table.insert(ids, tostring(soundId)) end

        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.Name = "DEXHubIntroMusic"
        sound.Volume = 0.8
        sound.Looped = false
        sound.PlayOnRemove = false
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        if playToken ~= M._introPlayToken then pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) return end
        M.introPlaybackSound = sound
        introSoundInstance = sound

        local startTime = math.max(0, tonumber(option.startTime) or 0)
        local played = false
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            local raw = tostring(id)
            local sid = raw:gsub("^rbxassetid://", "")
            if raw:match("^rbxasset://") or raw:match("^rbxassetid://%d+$") or sid:match("^%d+$") then
                sound.SoundId = raw:match("^rbxassetid://") and raw or (sid:match("^%d+$") and ("rbxassetid://" .. sid) or raw)
                pcall(function() sound.TimePosition = startTime end)
                pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
                played = true
                -- Do not wait for loading. Roblox resolves the audio asynchronously.
                break
            end
        end
        if not played then
            pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end)
            M.introPlaybackSound = nil
            introSoundInstance = nil
            warn("[DEXHub Audio] No valid Roblox audio ID for " .. tostring(option.name))
            return
        end

        task.delay(1, function()
            if M.introPlaybackSound == sound then
                pcall(function()
                    print("[DEXHub Audio] " .. tostring(option.name) .. " | id=" .. tostring(sound.SoundId) .. " | loaded=" .. tostring(sound.IsLoaded) .. " | length=" .. tostring(sound.TimeLength) .. " | playing=" .. tostring(sound.IsPlaying))
                end)
            end
        end)

        local clipDuration = math.max(0, tonumber(option.clipDuration) or tonumber(M.introClipDuration) or 10)
        if clipDuration <= 0 then clipDuration = 10 end
        task.delay(clipDuration, function()
            if playToken == M._introPlayToken and M.introPlaybackSound == sound then
                pcall(function() sound:Stop() end)
                pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end)
                M.introPlaybackSound = nil
                introSoundInstance = nil
            end
        end)
    end)
end
local DEXHUB_VOICE_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_VOICE_FILE = "DEXHub_DexHubVoice.mp3"
local function getDEXHubVoiceAsset()
    local ok, asset = pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(DEXHUB_VOICE_FILE) then
            local getter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
            if getter then return getter(DEXHUB_VOICE_FILE) end
        end
        if writefile and (getcustomasset or getsynasset) then
            local decoded = HS:Base64Decode(DEXHUB_VOICE_B64)
            writefile(DEXHUB_VOICE_FILE, decoded)
            local getter = getcustomasset or getsynasset
            return getter(DEXHUB_VOICE_FILE)
        end
    end)
    return ok and asset or nil
end
function M.runDEXHubIntro(onFinished)
    onFinished = onFinished or function() end
    if M._simpleIntroRunning then return end
    M._simpleIntroRunning = true

    -- Keep the selected intro music playing underneath the DEX HUB voice.
    if M.introSoundEnabled then
        pcall(function() M.playIntroMusic() end)
    end

    -- Spoken DEX HUB is synchronized to the title reveal.

    local PlayerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
    if not PlayerGui then M._simpleIntroRunning=false; onFinished(); return end

    local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DEXHubDuelsIntro")
    if old then old:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "DEXHubDuelsIntro"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
    gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    gui.Parent = PlayerGui

    local bg = Instance.new("Frame")
    bg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
    bg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(3,4,10)
    bg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bg.Parent = gui

    local function frame(name,size,pos,color,trans,z)
        local f=Instance.new("Frame")
        f.Name=name; f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); f.Size=size; f.Position=pos
        f.BackgroundColor3=color; f.BackgroundTransparency=trans or 0; f.BorderSizePixel=0
        f.ZIndex=z or 2; f.Parent=bg
        return f
    end

    -- Atmospheric center glow.
    local glow=frame("CoreGlow",UDim2.fromScale(.42,.42),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Color3.fromRGB(0,110,255),.82,2)
    Instance.new("UICorner",glow).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)

    -- Three animated rings, deliberately UI-only.
    local rings={}
    for i=1,3 do
        local r=frame("EnergyRing"..i,UDim2.fromScale(.12+i*.055,.12+i*.055),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Color3.fromRGB(30,180,255),1,3)
        local c=Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0); c.Parent=r
        local st=Instance.new("UIStroke"); st.Thickness=2+i; st.Color=Color3.fromRGB(40,190,255); st.Transparency=.18; st.Parent=r
        rings[i]={obj=r,stroke=st,phase=i*.55}
    end

    -- Small orbiting sparks.
    local sparks={}
    for i=1,18 do
        local dot=frame("Spark"..i,UDim2.fromOffset(3+(i%3),3+(i%3)),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5),Color3.fromRGB(100,220,255),.1,4)
        local c=Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0); c.Parent=dot
        sparks[i]=dot
    end

    local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Name="DEXHubTitle"; title.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
    title.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.47); title.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.9,.2)
    title.BackgroundTransparency=1; title.Text="DEX HUB"; title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    title.TextScaled=true; title.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
    title.TextTransparency=1; title.ZIndex=7; title.Parent=bg
    local ts=Instance.new("UIStroke"); ts.Thickness=3; ts.Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,190,255); ts.Transparency=1; ts.Parent=title

    local sub=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5); sub.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.61); sub.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.6,.05)
    sub.BackgroundTransparency=1; sub.Text="INITIALIZING  //  DEXHUB"; sub.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    sub.TextScaled=true; sub.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,190,215); sub.TextTransparency=1; sub.ZIndex=7; sub.Parent=bg

    local line=frame("Progress",UDim2.fromScale(.001,.006),UDim2.fromScale(.5,.68),Color3.fromRGB(0,200,255),0,7)
    local lineGlow=Instance.new("UIStroke"); lineGlow.Thickness=4; lineGlow.Color=Color3.fromRGB(0,160,255); lineGlow.Transparency=.55; lineGlow.Parent=line

    local skip=Instance.new("TextButton")
    skip.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1); skip.BackgroundTransparency=1; skip.Text=""; skip.ZIndex=20; skip.Parent=gui

    local finished=false
    local animAlive=true
    local voiceSound=nil
    local function stopVoice()
        if voiceSound then
            pcall(function() voiceSound:Stop() end)
            pcall(function() voiceSound:Destroy() end)
            voiceSound=nil
        end
    end
    local function startDEXHubVoice()
        stopVoice()
        pcall(function()
            local voiceAsset = getDEXHubVoiceAsset()
            if not voiceAsset then return end
            voiceSound = Instance.new("Sound")
            voiceSound.Name = "DEXHubVoiceIntro"
            voiceSound.SoundId = voiceAsset
            voiceSound.Volume = 4
            voiceSound.PlaybackSpeed = 1
            voiceSound.Looped = false
            voiceSound.Parent = SoundService
            voiceSound:Play()
        end)
    end
    local function finish()
        if finished then return end
        finished=true; animAlive=false; M._simpleIntroRunning=false
        stopVoice()
        pcall(function()
            for _,o in ipairs({title,ts,sub,bg}) do
                local props={}
                if o==title then props.TextTransparency=1 elseif o==ts then props.Transparency=1 elseif o==sub then props.TextTransparency=1 else props.BackgroundTransparency=1 end
                TweenService:Create(o,TweenInfo.new(.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),props):Play()
            end
            TweenService:Create(line,TweenInfo.new(.25),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,.006)}):Play()
        end)
        task.delay(.36,function() pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end); onFinished() end)
    end
    skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
        if not processed and not finished and input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then finish() end
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        -- Start the spoken “DEX HUB” at the exact same moment as the title reveal.
        startDEXHubVoice()
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(title,TweenInfo.new(.65,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{TextTransparency=0,Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.50)}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(ts,TweenInfo.new(.65),{Transparency=.05}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(sub,TweenInfo.new(.5),{TextTransparency=0}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(line,TweenInfo.new(2.8,Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=UDim2.fromScale(.72,.006)}):Play()
        end)
        local t0=os.clock()
        while animAlive and os.clock()-t0<3.8 do
            local t=os.clock()-t0
            pcall(function()
                glow.Size=UDim2.fromScale(.42+.035*math.sin(t*3),.42+.035*math.sin(t*3))
                for i,r in ipairs(rings) do
                    local sc=.12+i*.055+.018*math.sin(t*3+r.phase)
                    r.obj.Size=UDim2.fromScale(sc,sc)
                    r.obj.Rotation=(t*(35+i*18)+i*35)%360
                    r.stroke.Transparency=.12+.18*math.sin(t*4+r.phase)
                end
                for i,dot in ipairs(sparks) do
                    local a=t*(.9+(i%4)*.08)+i*.35
                    local rad=.13+(i%5)*.028
                    dot.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5+math.cos(a)*rad,.5+math.sin(a)*rad)
                    dot.BackgroundTransparency=.15+.35*(.5+.5*math.sin(a*3))
                end
                ts.Thickness=2.5+1.5*(.5+.5*math.sin(t*5))
            end)
            task.wait(.035)
        end
        if animAlive then finish() end
    end)
end

local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG1_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG2_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG3_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG4_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_B64 = { [1] = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG1_B64, [2] = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG2_B64, [3] = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG3_B64, [4] = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG4_B64 }
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_ASSETS = {}
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_NAMES = { [1] = "Venom", [2] = "Luffy", [3] = "Sasuke", [4] = "Anime" }
local function DEXHUB_GetCustomAsset(path)
    local funcs = {}
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then table.insert(funcs, getcustomasset) end
    if type(getsynasset) == "function" then table.insert(funcs, getsynasset) end
    if type(getasset) == "function" then table.insert(funcs, getasset) end
    pcall(function() if syn and type(syn.getcustomasset) == "function" then table.insert(funcs, syn.getcustomasset) end end)
    for _, fn in ipairs(funcs) do
        local ok, asset = pcall(fn, path)
        if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then return asset end
    end
    return nil
end
local function DEXHUB_LoadCustomImage(slot)
    slot = tonumber(slot)
    if not slot or slot < 1 or slot > 4 then return nil end
    if DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_ASSETS[slot] then return DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_ASSETS[slot] end
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local file = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_FILES[slot]
    local exists = false
    if type(isfile) == "function" then
        pcall(function() exists = isfile(file) == true end)
    end
    if not exists then
        local b64 = DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_B64[slot]
        if type(b64) ~= "string" or b64 == "" then return nil end
        local chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
        local clean = b64:gsub('[^'..chars..'=]', '')
        local out, n = {}, 1
        for i = 1, #clean, 4 do
            local a = chars:find(clean:sub(i,i), 1, true)
            local b = chars:find(clean:sub(i+1,i+1), 1, true)
            local c = chars:find(clean:sub(i+2,i+2), 1, true)
            local d = chars:find(clean:sub(i+3,i+3), 1, true)
            if not a or not b then break end
            a=a-1; b=b-1; c=(c and c-1 or 0); d=(d and d-1 or 0)
            out[n]=string.char(a*4 + math.floor(b/16)); n=n+1
            if clean:sub(i+2,i+2) ~= '=' then out[n]=string.char((b%16)*16 + math.floor(c/4)); n=n+1 end
            if clean:sub(i+3,i+3) ~= '=' then out[n]=string.char((c%4)*64 + d); n=n+1 end
        end
        pcall(function() writefile(file, table.concat(out)) end)
    end
    local asset = DEXHUB_GetCustomAsset(file)
    if asset then
        DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMAGE_ASSETS[slot] = asset
        return asset
    end
    return nil
end
-- Warm the four embedded image assets once so the picker and UI can use them immediately.
task.spawn(function()
    for slot = 1, 4 do
        pcall(function() DEXHUB_LoadCustomImage(slot) end)
        task.wait()
    end
end)
function DEXHUB_ResolveImage(id)
    id = tonumber(id) or 0
    if id < 0 then return DEXHUB_LoadCustomImage(-id) or "" end
    if id > 0 then return "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id) end
    return ""
end

st.Transparency = 0 st.Thickness = 2 end end) return b end --[[ DEXHUB EMBEDDED GAARA MENU BACKGROUND
     This image is stored inside this script as Base64 data.
     It is used ONLY for the DEXHUB menu panel.
]]
local DEXHUB_GAARA_IMAGE_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG1_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG2_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG3_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_CUSTOM_IMG4_B64 = ""
local DEXHUB_GAARA_FILE = "DEXHUB_Gaara_Menu_4K.jpg"
local DEXHUB_GAARA_ASSET = nil

local function DEXHUB_LoadEmbeddedGaara()
    if DEXHUB_GAARA_ASSET then return DEXHUB_GAARA_ASSET end
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        local b64chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
        local clean = DEXHUB_GAARA_IMAGE_B64:gsub('[^'..b64chars..'=]', '')
        local out = {}
        local bit = bit32
        local n = 1
        for i = 1, #clean, 4 do
            local a = b64chars:find(clean:sub(i,i), 1, true)
            local b = b64chars:find(clean:sub(i+1,i+1), 1, true)
            local c = b64chars:find(clean:sub(i+2,i+2), 1, true)
            local d = b64chars:find(clean:sub(i+3,i+3), 1, true)
            if not a or not b then break end
            a=a-1; b=b-1; c=(c and c-1 or 0); d=(d and d-1 or 0)
            out[n]=string.char(bit.lshift(a,2)+bit.rshift(b,4)); n=n+1
            if clean:sub(i+2,i+2) ~= '=' then out[n]=string.char(bit.lshift(bit.band(b,15),4)+bit.rshift(c,2)); n=n+1 end
            if clean:sub(i+3,i+3) ~= '=' then out[n]=string.char(bit.lshift(bit.band(c,3),6)+d); n=n+1 end
        end
        writefile(DEXHUB_GAARA_FILE, table.concat(out))
        DEXHUB_GAARA_ASSET = getcustomasset(DEXHUB_GAARA_FILE)
    end)
    if ok then return DEXHUB_GAARA_ASSET end
    return nil
end
